supplemental_root_recurrence.driver_source:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts import test_signal_compose as flow
from scripts.authority_custodian import verify_plan
from scripts.compare_pep import ROOT,command
from scripts.compare_supply_chain import sha256
from scripts.test_authority_key_rotation import AUTHORITY_SOURCES,IMPORTED_SOURCE_SHA256,AuthorityLab

class ReusedImageLab(AuthorityLab):
 def prepare(self):
  observed=json.loads((ROOT/'runtime/c02/c04/authority-final2/summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
  image=observed['certificate_execution_image_id']
  command(['docker','tag',image,self.image])
  self.report['certificate_execution_image_id']=image
  self.report['source_input_sha256']={name:sha256(ROOT/name) for name in AUTHORITY_SOURCES}
  actual=json.loads(command(['docker','run','--rm','--network','none','--read-only','--entrypoint','python','-i',self.image,'-c',
   'import hashlib,json,sys;from pathlib import Path;print(json.dumps({p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in json.load(sys.stdin)}))'],input=json.dumps(AUTHORITY_SOURCES)))
  flow.require(actual==IMPORTED_SOURCE_SHA256==self.report['source_input_sha256'],'supplemental_source_match')
  self.report['authority_image_source_sha256']=actual
  self.report['schema']='authority-root-recurrence-supplement-1'
  self.save()

lab=ReusedImageLab(ROOT/'runtime/c02/c04/authority-recurrence2')
lab.key_smoke=True
try:
 lab.prepare();lab.smoke()
 first=lab.coordinator_state()['history'][0]
 lab.private_rpc("""import json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.certificate_controller import atomic
s=json.loads(Path('/state/state.json').read_bytes());c=next(c for c in s['credentials'].values() if c['name']=='collector')
atomic('/state/previous-root-client.pem',c['current']);atomic('/state/previous-root-client.key',Path(c['key']).read_bytes());print('{}')""")
 lab.update_authority_periods({'root':1,'issuer':3600,'jwk':3600})
 second=lab.drive_until(lambda s:s['phase']=='idle' and s['epoch']==2,'root_recurrence',timeout=180)
 last=second['history'][-1]
 flow.require(last['changed']=={'root':True,'issuer':True,'jwk':False},'root_independent_timer')
 flow.require(last['root_public_key_sha256']!=first['root_public_key_sha256'],'second_new_root_key')
 verify_plan(last['plan'],first['plan']['root'],epoch=2,previous=first['plan_hash'])
 lab.private_rpc("""import json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.certificate_controller import save
p=json.loads(Path('/managed/smoke/profile.json').read_bytes());p.update(cert='previous-root-client.pem',key='previous-root-client.key',ca='root.pem');save(Path('/state/previous-root-client.json'),p);print('{}')""")
 denied=lab.request(lab.controller,{'tls_profile':'/state/previous-root-client.json','path':'/health/live'})
 healthy=lab.request(lab.controller,{'tls_profile':'/managed/smoke/profile.json','path':'/health/live'})
 lab.report['supplemental_probe_statuses']={'old_root':denied['status'],'current_root':healthy['status']};lab.save()
 flow.require(denied['status']==0 and healthy['status']==200,'retired_successor_root_tls_denied_with_positive_control')
 lab.private_rpc("from pathlib import Path;[ (Path('/state')/name).unlink() for name in ['previous-root-client.pem','previous-root-client.key','previous-root-client.json'] ];print('{}')")
 lab.report['supplemental_history']=second['history']
 lab.report['supplemental_checks']=[{'label':'root1_to_root2_signed_successor_and_independent_root_timer','passed':True},
  {'label':'previous_root1_client_rejected_by_tls','passed':True,'status':denied['status']},
  {'label':'current_root2_client_healthy_control','passed':True,'status':healthy['status']}]
 lab.report['counted_in_394_repeated_graph_assertions']=False
 lab.report['completed']=True
except Exception as exc:
 lab.report['failure']=str(exc) if isinstance(exc,flow.CheckFailed) else type(exc).__name__
 if hasattr(lab,'authority_profile'):lab.report['failure_coordinator_state']=lab.coordinator_state()
 raise
finally:
 lab.report['finished_at']=flow.timestamp();lab.cleanup()
print(json.dumps({'supplemental_completed':lab.report['completed'],'cleanup':lab.report['cleanup']}))
